description: PAID ($0.0027 USDC via x402). Before adding a dependency: give an npm or PyPI package (and optionally an exact version; default latest). Returns every vulnerability OSV.dev lists for that version (ids, CVE aliases, severity as its database labels it, fixed versions), whether it is deprecated (npm) or yanked (PyPI), licence, https source repository, publish dates, latest version, last week's downloads, runtime dependency and maintainer counts, and risk flags from a stated rule list. It reads registry metadata and advisories, not the code; 'no vulnerabilities' means none known to OSV. An unknown package or version, or an outage, answers 4xx/502 and is not charged. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

ecosystem.description: Which registry the name is on: npm (default) or pypi

name.description: The package name: an npm package (lodash, @types/node) or a PyPI project (requests, Django)

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

version.description: An exact published version to analyse (4.17.20, 2.31.0). Omit for the latest release; ranges like ^4 are refused
